Septic System 101

Understanding Your Septic System for a
Worry-Free Property

Our Services

Average Repair Cost

Know the
Warning Signs

Watch for slow drains, gurgling pipes, sewage odors, wet yard areas, or backups – if you notice any of these, call us for an inspection.

Regular Maintenence
is Key

Schedule inspections every 1-3 years and pump your tank as recommended to extend your system’s life and prevent costly emergencies.

Be Mindful
of Your Drain

Avoid flushing non-biodegradables, use septic-safe products, keep grease and keep harsh chemicals out of drains to maintain your system’s health and efficiency.

Protect
Your Drainfield

Preserve your drainfield’s efficiency by avoiding vehicle traffic, deep-rooted plants, and ensuring proper drainage away from the area.

Serving the Fraser Valley with Pride

Chilliwack Valley Septic is dedicated to providing top-notch septic services throughout the Fraser Valley. Our local expertise ensures that we understand the unique challenges of septic systems in our area.
